content:
What if the Atlas includes a tiny “pause here” marker for places where someone
can watch the water without having to buy anything? The harbor steps already
appear in [the field day](/note/journal/2026-08-27_field_day), but this needs a return
visit before it becomes a recommendation.

Reference: https://www.pps.org/article/what-makes-a-successful-place

Next action: ask [Sofia](/note/people/sofia_rossi) whether the bench is accessible at
different times of day.
